units.source_text: 库拉巴喀倾尽全神、铿锵有力地弹奏着钢琴。

en.t: Kurabakka was playing the piano with all his concentration and with ringing force.

units.source_text: 忽然，“禁止演奏”的声音如雷鸣般地在会场回响。

en.t: Suddenly, the cry of "No playing!" echoed through the hall like thunder.

units.source_text: 我吓了一跳，不禁回头望去。

en.t: I was startled and could not help turning around to look.

units.source_text: 没错，声音是坐在最后一排、比其他河童高出一头的警察发出来的。

en.t: Yes, the voice came from a policeman sitting in the very last row, a head taller than the other kappa.

units.source_text: 我扭头看的时候，警察依然稳如泰山，

en.t: When I turned to look, the policeman still sat there as steady as a mountain,

units.source_text: 一声还比一声高地喊道：“禁止演奏！”

en.t: and shouted louder and louder, "No playing!"
